import numpy as np

A = np.array([[4, 2, 1],
              [2, 5, 3],
              [1, 3, 2]])

eigenvalues, eigenvectors = np.linalg.eig(A)

v1 = eigenvectors[:, 0]
lam1 = eigenvalues[0]
A_v1 = A @ v1
lambda_v1 = lam1 * v1

v2 = eigenvectors[:, 1]
ortho_check = np.dot(v1, v2)

A_reconstructed = eigenvectors @ np.diag(eigenvalues) @ eigenvectors.T

spectral_radius = np.max(np.abs(eigenvalues))

print(f"Eigenvalues: {eigenvalues}")
print(f"A @ v1 = {A_v1}")
print(f"lambda1 * v1 = {lambda_v1}")
print(f"Orthogonality check (v1 . v2): {ortho_check:.6f}")
print(f"Reconstruction error: {np.max(np.abs(A - A_reconstructed)):.2e}")
print(f"Spectral radius: {spectral_radius:.4f}")
